evidence.evidence_text: We propose BloomScrub, a remarkably simple yet highly effective inference-time approach that provides certified copyright takedown.
This has driven the development of “copyright takedown” methods—post-training approaches aimed at preventing models from generating content substantially similar to copyrighted ones.

While current mitigation approaches are somewhat effective for average-case risks, we demonstrate that they overlook worst-case copyright risks exhibited by the existence of long, verbatim quotes from copyrighted sources.
This has driven the development of “copyright takedown” methods—post-training approaches aimed at preventing models from generating content substantially similar to copyrighted ones.
